title: Rundeck: When Jetty's `HttpClient` make a request to a server through a forward proxy, the server may reply with a 407…
description: A security vulnerability in Rundeck affects versions prior to 6.0.1-r11. The issue arises when Jetty's HttpClient makes requests through a forward proxy and the server responds with a 407 Proxy Authentication Required status. This vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 8.2. A fix is available in Rundeck version 6.0.1-r11.
